[LHYD.10.6.1] Two hydrations with different correlations produce
independent fact sets. Rules can join them freely (on
entity match, temporal proximity, etc.). `limit:` applies
**per-hydration**, not across — two `limit: 1000` calls
can contribute 2000 facts combined. Multi-hydration rules
should size their limits with the combined footprint in
mind.
